frozen_before: every outcome it can learn from: no RESOLUTION record exists in paper/catalysts.jsonl (the first H20 window ends 2026-11-27), so the learner is defined before any data it will be trained or judged on
owner_decision: 2026-10-29, the owner: 'The machine should self learn to understand how to triangulate a pre catalyst as accurately as possible and i want the machine to become confident. I also want the machine to detect the catalyst based on accurate predictions, not being lucky that its going up.'
what_it_learns: for every cone statement of every sealed catalyst set (and the joint TRIANGULATED statement where a family has a mechanism statement), how far the set's own features should move the sealed prior; one model per statement id, pooled across families so that evidence from one source informs another
ledger: paper/learner.jsonl, hash-chained and timestamped like the other ledgers, append-only

data.inputs: only fields sealed in the CATALYST_SET before its entry cutoff (the features list); never a price after the signal session
data.targets: cone outcomes of RESOLUTION records whose resolved_at is before the forecast time; TRIANGULATED is true when both of its component statements resolved true, false when either resolved false, and not used while either is ungraded
data.no_peeking: every forecast records the hash of the weights it used; paper-verify retrains from the resolutions dated before the forecast and must reproduce that hash

features: family one-hot (SEC13D, SEC13D_V2, DILUTION_8K, FORM4, FORM4_SHARP, IDX_INDEX)
close position in the day's range
log10 purchase value / 7 and its presence
lag from trade to filing / 30 (capped at 1)
largest holdings increase (capped at 5) / 5 and its presence
log10 market value / 10 and its presence

model.kind: logistic regression with the sealed prior's logit as an offset, so a coefficient is an adjustment to the prior
model.penalty: L2, lambda 20, on every coefficient including the intercept adjustment: with little data the learner stays at the prior
model.fit: iteratively reweighted least squares, at most 50 iterations, tolerance 1e-10

triangles.prior: the product of the two components' sealed priors

earned_confidence.rule: published = sigmoid(logit(prior) + alpha x (logit(raw) - logit(prior))): the learner speaks with the confidence it has earned
earned_confidence.alpha: min(1, n / 300) x clip(skill / 0.05, 0, 1), where n and skill come from the learner's own earlier raw forecasts that have since resolved: skill = 1 - Brier(raw) / Brier(sealed prior) on the same statements
earned_confidence.meaning: alpha 0 means the learner has not yet proven it beats the sealed priors and publishes them unchanged; alpha 1 means at least 300 resolved forecasts with a Brier skill of 5% or more

timing: learner-forecast runs after the catalyst-seal steps and before each set's entry cutoff; one forecast per set; a set past its cutoff is never forecast

scoring.forward_only: a forecast is scored only against outcomes that resolved after it was made
scoring.reported: Brier and log score of sealed prior, raw and published per statement; reliability in ten bins; alpha over time
scoring.earned_not_lucky: a gain (GAIN0_k true) is EARNED when the same set also beat its twins over the same horizon (BEATS_TWINS_k true) and, for a family with a mechanism statement, the mechanism happened; otherwise LUCKY (the market or sector carried it, or the stated catalyst never came). The report states both counts.
scoring.detection: among TRIANGULATED and BEATS_TWINS forecasts, the realised rate of the learner's top fifth against the family base rate

claim.statistic: per-session mean of (Brier of the sealed prior - Brier of the published forecast) over every scored (forecast, statement) pair, one-sided t against 0
claim.eligible: t >= that look's t_min and one-sided p < 0.05: the learner beats the sealed priors (ELIGIBLE FOR OWNER REVIEW)
claim.futility: from the 240 look, a mean at or below 0 is FAIL (futility): the learner adds nothing to the frozen priors

never: change a family rule, prior, twin draw, resolution or ledger line
feed back into any family's sealing (the families stay frozen; the learner sits beside them)
use an outcome resolved after its forecast
